author: Beth Reams
text: My Easter Sunday brought a horrible sewage drain backup with flooding in my basement bathroom.  Im so very thankful that Sherlock Homes was able to come over quickly and clear the drain. Being a holiday and a Sunday I was worried about getting help. They were fast, efficient, friendly and fairly priced. Very highly recommend!!!

author: Ashley L
text: Sump pump died. They came to the rescue and saved my basement from becoming an indoor pool. Same-day service, great work, and a few laughs along the way. Highly recommend!

author: Susan O'Connor
text: Washing machine hose sprung a leak in the evening.  Faucet kept leaking after being shut off.  James showed up within a half hour of my phone call and replaced hoses in less than another half hour.  Very efficient, friendly and professional.  (Teams previously sent to install new washers in past years, were unsuccessful when trying to remove this old hose, but James was persistent and fixed us up with a new set of stainless steel hoses.)

author: Amanda Morrow
text: I can’t recommend them enough. Came home at 5 pm to a burst water pipe raining water inside and outside our house. Called a few places who weren’t open/couldn’t come out soon enough. These 2 were at our house in less than 30 minutes and had the pipe fixed in about the same time. Top notch service, speed and price. Thank you!

author: Parker Dubb
text: Had James come out and do a sewer repair. He was super helpful, quick to respond, affordable pricing and did a fantastic job. I would highly recommend him for all your plumbing needs. Will definitely call him for everything plumbing from now on. Thank you James and your amazing team!
